I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and rendering are unchecked.

It follows `DESIGN.md`:
- **Layout:** 1280px wide inside `#component`, with 64px margins and 32px gutters. The four stat tiles sit in four equal columns.
- **Type:** the page heading is Unbounded Light in all caps at 56px, and the stat labels are 12px caps Archivo. Spacing, radii and letter-spacing use only the listed values.
- **Colors:** only the palette colors. The current nav item, "Overview", has an accent-tint pill and `aria-current="page"`.
- **Fonts:** no font files were provided and external loading isn't allowed. Unbounded and Archivo are named first, with system fonts as fallback. If those fonts aren't installed, the screen will render in the fallback.

I added a "Harbor" wordmark at the left of the top bar. It isn't in your content list, so remove it if you want the content exactly as given.
